name: Player Failover
author: James Arrowood
description: Hot failover between two FPP players. The backup runs as an FPP remote, mirroring the primary, and when the primary dies it becomes the MultiSync source mid-song without a restart or a gap, then hands the show back when the primary returns. On remotes it shows which player is active, acts as a witness against false failovers, and can run a local fallback sequence when no player is alive.
